name: Pontecorvo (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red.
history: Municipal flag of Pontecorvo, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 30 March 2004.
